bullets.text: Sole developer of a universal web platform in C# and Blazor (.NET 8) that adds custom dashboards and apps on top of third-party file-management platforms; designed and built the platform's own APIs.
Set up CI/CD with GitHub Actions and Azure Pipelines to build Docker images and deploy to Azure; provisioned and configured the Azure environments.
Wrote component tests with bUnit and maintained code quality through pull requests and code review.
Wrote API documentation, READMEs, user guides and developer templates for extending the platform with new apps and widgets.

Built a Python automation tool to migrate 75 projects (5,000 files, ~500 GB, plus thousands of rows of Excel metadata) with custom attributes from AStar to Autodesk Forma, completed in about 2 weeks against an estimated 4 months of manual work.
Integrated Autodesk Platform Services (ACC), Forma, Asite and Knowledge Share (GraphQL) APIs for client migrations and platform features.

Developed a prototype Revit add-in (C#, Revit API) providing an agentic AI assistant inside Revit via Azure AI Foundry, with multi-version support that detects installed Revit versions; generated stakeholder interest for further development.
Built a Godot MVP of a 4D crime-scene evidence visualiser, now used by the Metropolitan Police's Grenfell Tower investigation team.
Implemented AI models for client solutions with Azure AI Foundry, and built internal AI agents that match consultants to client requirements using Power Automate and Copilot.
Delivered a client's transition from MicroStation to Autodesk CAD, including their template files, and Power BI dashboards for reviewing MIDP.
Ran 3 workshops and training sessions for around 30 attendees on AI capabilities, NVIDIA Omniverse and sustainability.
Built a desktop PDF review tool in JavaScript using Electron and React, and Dynamo scripts automating Revit workflows; tools used by up to 10 staff at a time.
Provided BIM support and tooling to the whole office.
Assisted with, and at times managed, a 700-unit residential project; maintained delivery under tight deadlines after the team went from three people to one.
Supervised and onboarded 3 new staff members onto the project.

Built Unreal Engine VR visualisation software in two weeks to demonstrate a proposed Fab Lab conversion at Liverpool John Moores University; demoed successfully to the Vice-Chancellor and board of investors.
Developed personal game projects in Unreal Engine, Unity and Godot.
Worked across a diverse project portfolio, from client liaison to concept and construction drawings and visualisations.

projects.text: Self-hosted service stack in Docker on TrueNAS (previously Proxmox), including a Gitea server with Gitea Actions CI and VPN access for remote use.

projects.title: AI photo tagging
projects.text: Used the CLIP model (PyTorch, Hugging Face) to generate image embeddings and identify tags, organising a large personal photo library.
